title: System design from first principles to design review
intro: Design a parking service that can refuse the last space, survive a lost reply and recover its booking history. Trace each decision in a diagram, then inspect the rows or timings that would prove it wrong.
how: Start with two drivers and one parking space. Follow what each driver sees and what the service saves. The first two lessons can be done by hand. Their optional SQL examples show how to check the same answers in your browser.

modules.title: Bookings, busy periods and lost replies
modules.blurb: Check who booked the last space, size a test for the busy minutes and find a saved booking after a process stops.

modules.title: Data under concurrent use
modules.blurb: Protect inventory, handle retries, page history and bound staleness.

modules.title: Distributed work
modules.blurb: Deliver events, handle overload, move data and survive a partition.

modules.title: Operating and defending a design
modules.blurb: Reconcile payments, diagnose delays, recover data and defend a design under changed assumptions.

modules.blurb: Route uneven work, share simultaneous cache misses and test a recovering dependency.
